sources.quote: BR-310,"Roof rail bracket, extruded and cut",PRG-Y,A,MAT-6082-T5,COAT-TCP
Moving production to another site is a change of source.
A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before the first shipment.

findings.why: BR-310 belongs only to PRG-Y (Nordhavn). Moving the coating to a new line at Pinerolo is a change of production site, which Nordhavn treats as a change of source. Written Nordhavn approval (PPAP) is needed before the first shipment. No approval for this change is in force. Aurelia has no requirement here because BR-310 is not on an Aurelia program.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.
cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by the supplier; found at incoming inspection on BR-310.
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone supplies BR-310, which is made of EN AW-6082-T5. The 8D on cracks in 6082 material is still open, so the supplier has an open quality issue on this part's alloy. The re-audit lifted the company-level conditional status but did not close this 8D.
